# Notestify

> Notestify is a free AI study platform at https://www.notestify.com that turns
> PDFs, Word documents and PowerPoint slides into flashcards, quizzes and
> summaries, and schedules reviews using the SM-2 spaced repetition algorithm.

Notestify was built by Lester Lawrence Sanchez, a developer based in Cebu,
Philippines. It is free to use and runs on Google's Gemini API.

## What it does

- **Document to study material**: upload a PDF, DOCX or PPTX, or import a file
  from Google Drive. Text is extracted server-side and turned into flashcards,
  quizzes and summaries.
- **Spaced repetition**: reviews are scheduled with SM-2, the algorithm behind
  SuperMemo and Anki, so cards resurface as you are about to forget them.
- **AI tutor grounded in your own material**: the tutor answers from a deck,
  note or document you attach, rather than from general knowledge.
- **Daily reminder emails**: optional, off by default, and sent only on days
  you actually have cards due.
- **PDF annotation**: highlight and mark up uploaded PDFs in the browser.

## How it handles your data

- Content is stored in Supabase with row-level security, so a signed-in
  account can only ever read or write its own rows.
- AI features send text to Google's Gemini API. Notestify runs on the free
  Gemini tier, where Google may use submitted content to improve its products.
  This is stated plainly at https://www.notestify.com/privacy
- Google Drive imports use the `drive.file` scope only. Files are selected in
  Google's own Picker, so Notestify can access only what the user explicitly
  hands over, and cannot browse or list a user's Drive.
- Imported files are not stored. The text is extracted and the original is
  discarded.
- Self-service data export and account deletion are available in Settings.

- [About](https://www.notestify.com/about): who built it and why

## Technical

Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Supabase (Postgres, Auth and Storage),
Google Gemini, deployed on Vercel. Source at
https://github.com/realserted/Notestify
